rates.description: Daily reference rate with percentiles and volume, one row per business day: secured (sofr, tgcr, bgcr) or unsecured (effr, obfr). Rows come newest first.

family.desc: secured (SOFR, TGCR, BGCR) or unsecured (EFFR, OBFR)

ratetype.desc: rate name, lower case; it must belong to the family

soma_summary.description: Weekly (Wednesday) SOMA holdings totals in dollars by asset class (bills, notes and bonds, TIPS, FRN, MBS, agencies) since 2003-07-09: the whole history, about 1,200 rows.

soma_tsy_holdings.description: SOMA Treasury holdings on one as-of date, one row per CUSIP: maturity date, coupon, par value, inflation compensation, share of the issue outstanding, security type (Bills, NotesBonds, TIPS, FRN).

date.desc: an as-of date from soma_asofdates, YYYY-MM-DD

soma_tsy_wam.description: Weighted average maturity, in years, of the SOMA Treasury holdings on one as-of date. One row.

date.desc: an as-of date from soma_asofdates, YYYY-MM-DD

soma_asofdates.description: Every SOMA as-of date published, as one column (asOfDate).

tsy_operations.description: Fed Treasury purchase or sale operations in a date range, one row per operation (include=summary) or with the securities bought as JSON text in a details column (include=details).

include.desc: summary (one row per operation) or details (adds the securities)

pd_series.description: One primary dealer statistics series (positions, financing, transactions), weekly since 2013, in millions of dollars: one row per as-of date (asofdate, keyid, value).

timeseries.desc: series key from pd_catalog, e.g. PDPOSGST-TOT (net Treasury positions)

pd_catalog.description: Every primary dealer series key with its series break and description (about 1,500 rows; search it for the key you need).
